question: The perpendicular from the center O of the circle bisects the chord EF at G. If EF = 30 cm and the radius of the circle is 17 cm, then find the length of the perpendicular OG.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perpendicular from the center of a circle bisects the chord, so half of the chord = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm.

The radius, half-chord, and perpendicular distance form a right-angled triangle.

These lengths form a standard Pythagorean triplet: (8, 15, 17).

Since the hypotenuse (radius) is 17 cm and the base (half-chord) is 15 cm, the perpendicular distance must be 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**
